verdict.rationale: mParticle documents its own server-side HTTP APIs, including the Events API with a downloadable OpenAPI spec, the Warehouse Sync API and the Platform/Audiences API. These let it be driven programmatically without the UI. A per-batch development/production environment flag allows test traffic to be segregated, which suits automated pipelines. However, there is no CLI, no CI-specific guidance, and the OpenAPI spec covers only the Events API, so headless/CI use is implied rather than documented as a workflow. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration docs, machine-readable specs for the Platform/Profile APIs, an isolated sandbox/test tenant rather than just an environment flag, and hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use the Open API (previously known as Swagger) specification or similar tools to generate helper SDKs (using Swagger Codegen or OpenAPI Generator) for the Events API
which segregates development data from production data within the same account
with a Warehouse Sync API, SQL reference, and data mapping
